reason: PURE. The "Every batch lab-tested" line with a QR on the front caught me first, since a batch report is what I look for before NSF or USP. I would scan the QR in the listing photos, and if the report is real I would try one box for sleep, and the sachets would fit in my gym bag.
objection: It is a brand with zero reviews, and a lab report the brand chose to show me is not the same as NSF or USP certification. I want to see that the report is real and matches this batch.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report turned out to be generic, missing a batch number or not from the named lab, I would not buy. NSF or USP certification would make me buy more than one box.
